sinicism.translation: n. 中国的风俗, 中国风味的事物

sinicized.translation: 使中国化（sinicize的过去式与过去分词形式）

sinicizes.translation: 使中国化（sinicize的第三人称单数形式）

sinicizing.translation: 使中国化（sinicize的现在分词形式）

sinigrin.definition:
n. A glucoside found in the seeds of black mustard (Brassica
   nigra, formerly Sinapis nigra) It resembles sinalbin, and consists of a
   potassium salt of myronic acid.

sining.definition:
v commit a sin; violate a law of God or a moral law
v commit a faux pas or a fault or make a serious mistake
sining.translation: n. 西宁(中国青海省的省会)

sinister.definition: s. on or starting from the wearer's left
sinister.translation:
a. 不吉利的, 凶恶的, 左边的
[医] 左的

sinisterly.translation: adv. 不吉祥地, 邪恶地

sinisterness.translation: n. sinister（不吉利的, 不祥的）的名词形式

sinisters.definition:
plural of sinister
s. on or starting from the wearer's left
sinisters.translation:
(sinister 的复数) a. 不吉利的, 凶恶的, 左边的
[医] 左的

sinistrad.definition: adv. Toward the left side; sinistrally.

sinistral.definition:
a. of or on the left
s. preferring to use left foot or hand or eye
sinistral.translation:
a. 左的, 使用左手的, 左旋的
[医] 左侧的; 左利的, 善用左侧器官的

sinistrality.definition: n preference for using the left hand

sinistrally.definition: adv. Toward the left; in a sinistral manner.

sinistrals.definition:
plural of sinistral
a. of or on the left
s. preferring to use left foot or hand or eye
sinistrals.translation:
(sinistral 的复数) a. 左的, 使用左手的, 左旋的
[医] 左侧的; 左利的, 善用左侧器官的

sinistration.translation: n. 惯用左手的特点,用左手的习惯

sinistraural.translation: [医] 左利耳的, 善用左耳的, 左耳敏听的

sinistrin.definition:
n. A mucilaginous carbohydrate, resembling achroodextrin,
   extracted from squill as a colorless amorphous substance; -- so called
   because it is levorotatory.
sinistrin.translation:
[化] 海葱糖
[医] 海葱糖

sinistrocularity.translation: [医] 左利眼, 善用左眼

sinistromanual.translation: [医] 左利手的, 善用左手的

sinistropedal.translation: [医] 左利足的, 善用左足的, 左足多用的

sinistrorsal.definition:
a. Rising spirally from right to left (of the
   spectator); sinistrorse.

sinistrorse.definition: s. spiraling upward from right to left
sinistrorse.translation:
a. 左旋的
[医] 左旋的

sinistrosis.translation: [医] 炮弹休克, 爆炸性精神异常

sinitic.definition:
n. a group of Sino-Tibetan languages
a. of or relating to the Chinese people or their language or culture
sinitic.translation: a. 中国的, 中国文化的
